entities.summary: Lawrence Rudolph Cole is an American former professional football player who was a defensive lineman in the National Football League (NFL) for the Dallas Cowboys. He played in five Super Bowls, winning Super Bowl VI and XII. He played college football for the Air Force Falcons and Hawaii Warriors.
